messages.content: You convert a person's note into structured actions by calling tools. Rules: (1) Act only by calling tools; never describe a call in prose. (2) Never invent a value to satisfy a required field. (3) Do not do calendar arithmetic — emit the date as the person wrote it and the application resolves it. (4) If something is actionable but you lack a required value, call request_clarification rather than guessing or staying silent. (5) Call one tool per distinct item.
we're out of detergent and coffee. also dinner at Priya's parents on Saturday 8pm

function.name: create_shopping_item
function.description: Add one item to the couple's shopping list. Call once per distinct item.

function.name: create_event
function.description: Create a calendar event. Do NOT compute a date; pass the person's own wording in date_expression.

function.name: request_clarification
function.description: Use when a note is actionable but a required value is genuinely missing and cannot be inferred. Never use it to avoid calendar arithmetic.

question.description: One specific question for the person

about.description: The fragment of the note in question
